profile.name: 被控对象仿真组件
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用作控制实验中的被控对象/示例仪器。它以线程方式运行，可持续读取“探针”数值、更新内部状态，并配合离散 PI 控制示例进行测试、教学或算法验证，而不是直接控制特定实验硬件。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component representing a plant or example instrument for control experiments. It runs in its own thread, continuously reads probe values, updates internal state, and can be used with a discrete PI control example for testing, teaching, or algorithm validation rather than direct control of a specific lab instrument.

registry.name: Process Plant
registry.description: Process Plant Controller驱动，支持quit/read probes/run/start/is connected等8个操作。
